patch.objective: Deciding who stays accountable when the Product Owner delegates Product Backlog work
secondaryObjectives: Organizing several Scrum Teams on one product around one Product Backlog, one Product Owner and one Product Goal

sources.cite: Ken Schwaber and Jeff Sutherland, The Scrum Guide (November 2020)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-16 directly (the PDF). Daily Scrum: 'The purpose of the Daily Scrum is to inspect progress toward the Sprint Goal and adapt the Sprint Backlog as necessary'; 'a 15-minute event for the Developers of the Scrum Team'. Reused for REQ-336 from this course's csm-sprint-status-meeting-daily-scrum (the same reading and date); the objective wording is the course seed's.

The company, the product, the team and the people are fictional. The minutes or days each step takes and the effects of each decision are teaching simplifications for exam practice, not measured values.
